create_td3_default_config: create a TD3Config instance with all default values for the TD3 reinforcement learning agent
configure_td3_learning_rates: configure TD3Config with custom policy and critic learning rates for training
configure_td3_replay_buffer: configure TD3Config replay buffer options like min_replay_size and max_replay_size
configure_td3_target_noise: configure TD3Config target network noise parameters sigma target_sigma and noise_clip
configure_td3_offline_rl: configure TD3Config with bc_alpha for offline reinforcement learning with behavior cloning regularization
